name: Karma
notes: Karma is played as a pure caster here: her kit never touches basic attacks (no on-hit, no attack-speed steroid, no reset), so attack.never is set and attack-speed / on-hit items get no value from her, as instructed.

Casts go one at a time: Q and W each have a 0.25s cast time (per the dossier) during which no other cast and no attack starts; Mantra (R) has no cast time and no cost, so it never itself waits out a busy period, but it still cannot start inside a Q or W cast that is already in progress.

Opening: Mantra (R) is cast at t=0 (cooldown starts on cast); its charge is spent immediately on the very next Q, turning it into Soulflare. The bonus impact and field damage this produces are attributed to R (the source of the empowerment), not Q, since Mantra itself never deals damage on its own cast.

Q (Inner Flame/Soulflare) is recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight; its impact damage (and, when Mantra-empowered, its bonus impact) lands as the 0.25s cast starts, then the cast time keeps Karma busy; the field detonation lands 1.5s later per the wiki's stated field duration, as its own timed event (not a cast).

Whenever Mantra comes off cooldown it is recast immediately, and the resulting charge is always reserved for the next Q cast, never W or E, since only Q's Mantra bonus deals damage (per the dossier's rotation).

W (Focused Resolve) is cast on cooldown for its initial damage, which lands as its 0.25s cast starts; since the dummy is stationary and never breaks the tether, its aftereffect damage always lands 2s later as its own timed event (not a cast).
E (Inspire/Defiance) is never cast: it only shields/heals and has no offensive value against a stationary dummy, so it is skipped entirely.

Gathering Fire (Passive): read as each individual damage instance -- Q's impact and field separately, W's initial hit and aftereffect separately -- independently cutting Mantra's current cooldown by 4s, matching the wiki's 4x10=40s cap math for 5 champions hit by two instances each; this is the chosen reading of an ambiguous passage.
Mana costs are not modeled: Karma's costs (Q/W/E, 40-80 mana) are modest relative to a level-16 mana pool and are unlikely to bind inside a short fight.

Mantra's 8-second empowerment window (how long an unspent charge lasts) is quoted only in wiki text, not confirmed anywhere in the bin; it is listed under assumed and only matters for bookkeeping, since the rotation always spends the charge on the very next Q, well inside 8s.

assumed.why: Mantra's 8s empowerment window before an unspent charge decays is stated only in wiki text with no corresponding bin field; used only for internal decay bookkeeping since the charge is always consumed on the next Q well within 8s.
